subject: TopoHealth demo — request to consolidate into exec window
messages:
From: Amy Cho <amy.cho@topohealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@topohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to compress Wednesday demo for exec window

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for setting up next week’s technical walkthrough. Our exec team just carved out a hard 30-minute slot on Wednesday (12/02) at 11:00–11:30am PT to see a concise run of the inference flow and cost/latency numbers.

Is there any way your team can compress the session into a tight 30-minute briefing focused on:
- brief context (2–3 min)
- core demo of end-to-end latency and failover (15 min)
- cost/quantization tradeoffs and Q&A (10 min)

If that’s not possible with the currently scheduled team, please let us know alternatives (another day/time this week, or an exec-focused condensed deck). Execs are locked in at 11:00–11:30 PT on Wednesday, so that window is preferred.

Appreciate the flexibility — Amy

Amy Cho
Head of Platform Strategy | TopoHealth
amy.cho@topohealth.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Amy Cho <amy.cho@topohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@topohealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to compress Wednesday demo for exec window

Thanks for the heads-up, Amy — we can absolutely make something exec-friendly.

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Amy Cho <amy.cho@topohealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for setting up next week’s technical walkthrough...

Quick update from our side: Karthik (SE) is on the original invite and is the best person to run the latency/security segment, but he is travelling for an onsite customer on Wednesday morning and is currently double-booked in our calendar. I don’t want to promise we can cover everything with the same depth in 30 minutes unless we reassign the lead or shorten the scope.

Two options that should work: 
1) Marissa Cole (cc’d) steps in to run the compact exec demo end-to-end (we can keep Karthik on standby for the first 10–15 minutes for quick context/handoff).
2) Keep Karthik as lead but move the compact session to Thursday 11:00–11:45 PT (exec team availability permitting).

Amy — which do you prefer? If you’ll accept Marissa as the lead, we’ll send an updated agenda and confirm the 11:00–11:30 slot on Wednesday. If the execs are strict about Karthik leading, we’ll propose Thursday immediately.

I’ve attached a short exec agenda draft we can compress further if needed.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Amy Cho <amy.cho@topohealth.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@topohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to compress Wednesday demo for exec window

Hey all,

Sorry for the late ping — I’m onsite with a customer that afternoon and my calendar shows an unavoidable briefing that overlaps with the 11:00 PT exec window. I can do one of the following:

- Join at 11:00 for the first 10–12 minutes to set the technical baseline and then hand off to Marissa to run the live demo and Q&A, OR
- Swap entirely and have Marissa lead end-to-end (she’s been shadowing this account and has the perf figures).

If you want continuity from my deep-dive, I’ll join the first segment and then drop out. If the execs prefer a single lead for clarity, Marissa leading is fine with me.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Amy Cho <amy.cho@topohealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:52:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to compress Wednesday demo for exec window — confirmed lead and agenda

Hi Amy — happy to take point for the condensed session. Confirming: Wednesday 12/02, 11:00–11:30 PT (exec slot).

Planned brief agenda (finalized):
- 0:00–02:00 — Quick context & goals (Sofia)
- 02:00–12:00 — End-to-end demo: request path, KV cache, failover behavior (me)
- 12:00–22:00 — Latency/cost summary & quantization options (me with 2 slides from Karthik)
- 22:00–30:00 — Focused Q&A (execs)

I’ve attached the compressed agenda and a one-page ROI sheet for execs. If you want me to tighten any section, say the word and I’ll pare slides. I’ll also plan to have Karthik drop in for the first 10 minutes to introduce the architecture and then hand off.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: TopoHealth-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), TopoHealth-ROI-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
